free_tier.stated: No perpetual free volume. Pay-as-you-go per GB, per storage class (Hotbox/Icebox/Backup).
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: bonus expires in 60 days and unused balance is revoked; bonus cannot be spent on CDN, licences or marketplace

egress.terms: Metered: 'Outgoing traffic is any downloading of information from the bucket .. In both cases, the bucket is accessed using an external IP address'. Charged per GB on Hotbox and Icebox; only incoming traffic and API calls are free.

tooling: S3-compatible API, rclone via S3 backend; the only free axis is the 5 000 RUB (individual) / 12 000 RUB (legal entity) welcome bonus, 60 days
chaining: welcome bonus only: 5 000 RUB per individual, one-time, 60-day expiry, requires a corporate-domain email and an RF IP; = N identities x ~60 days of storage, not perpetual
limits_note: bonus expires in 60 days and unused balance is revoked; bonus cannot be spent on CDN, licences or marketplace
reliability_note: Promotional credit model expires after 60 days unless upgraded to paid tiers. Outbound egress is billed at metered per-gigabyte rates.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

evidence.proved: 'Outgoing traffic is any downloading of information from the bucket ... you pay for: Volume of stored data (per GB). Outgoing traffic (per GB)'
